I can build that block for you, but first let me see where you are right now so it fits your logged training. Nothing is logged for you yet: no program, no sessions in the last 12 weeks, no goals. So I can't read your progress from the app, and I won't guess at your loads.

Tell me what you're after and what you have to train with, and I'll build the block around that. Something like "4 days a week, full gym, want more size in the chest and back" is plenty. Once you've logged a few sessions, I can also tell you what's working and where to push next.
